title: Laparoscopic surgeries
summary: Explore how laparoscopic (keyhole) surgeries offer faster recovery, less pain, and minimal scarring for a variety of conditions.
intro: Laparoscopic surgery is a minimally invasive technique that uses small incisions and a camera to perform operations inside the abdomen.
It is commonly used for gallbladder removal, appendectomy, hernia repair, and gynecological procedures, offering a quicker and safer recovery.
causes: Treatment of abdominal or pelvic adhesions
benefits: Laparoscopic surgery offers less post-operative pain, faster healing, smaller scars, and lower risk of complications compared to open surgery.
